content_of_post_to_answer: What's one productivity habit that has made the biggest difference for you?
answer: The productivity habit that changed things for me was separating “deciding what matters” from “doing the work.” Many people try to improve focus by working harder, but the bigger problem is often spending energy on low-value decisions all day. A simple weekly review of priorities made my daily work calmer because I stopped negotiating with myself every morning. The surprising part is that productivity is less about managing time and more about protecting attention from things that never deserved it.
